title: Mixed Event — Singing Among the Cherry Blossoms — Episode4 Very First Applause

meta.Event Outline: Ichika continues her singing practice with Nene in the hopes of improving as much as possible for Shiho. She decides to try performing on the street in order to gain more confidence, but what unexpected encounter awaits her there...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But the crowd's as big as ever.
I can't help but feel a little nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I still feel like I can't sing...
Is today going to end the same way...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (With me not getting any closer to Shiho's level...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So to make sure that I don't disappoint them and to catch up to them, I'm practicing as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure Shiho feels the same way about you. That has to be why she's willing to teach you so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I have to change.
They won't hear me at this rate...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho's already taught me so much, so I need to keep getting better and better!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need my song to be heard!)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hm? Is someone doing a show?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Whoa, listen!
She has an awesome voice!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(They're all watching...
They're listening to my song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh no, my hands are starting to shake...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want them to hear my song!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want everyone passing by to hear my music!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Put everything into the last chorus and verse...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My hands are shaking and my legs are so wobbly. I can feel my heart pounding throughout my entire body too. It's so loud...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never knew it felt so good to sing like this in front of other people...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, everyone! Thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line:
That was a great song!
We should be thanking you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to do that again...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright, I think we're all ready.
Honami, count us in.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, that was amazing!
Like, more amazing than before!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right! Your voice was so powerful but also beautiful. It felt like I was being immersed in it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't believe you improved this much in so little time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like all your hard work is paying off, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It is.
I have you to thank, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Were you doing extra sessions with Miku or something? Please, tell us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What do you think, Ichika?
Shall we tell them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll let you decide, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then it'll be our little secret.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, come on! Ichi's not allowed to hide anything from me...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But she really has been getting better and better. I need to do the same and keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so. I was about to say that you might even be stage ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Shiho. That means so much coming from you...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. My dream is to reach the same level that you want to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want you to be able to play to your heart's content, so I'll keep trying my best...!
